title: M1.7: Mail infrastructure in CDK: shared ingress stack and per-environment mail domain
description:
Add infra/lib stacks: a shared ChatticusMailIngress stack owning the single active SES receipt rule set of the account and region, and per environment a mail stack with the delegated mail zone (mail.develop.chattic.us, mail.staging.chattic.us, mail.chattic.us), SES domain identity with Easy DKIM, custom MAIL FROM, DMARC record, wildcard MX to SES inbound, S3 bucket for raw mail (private, encrypted, 30 day lifecycle), receipt rule for that environment's domain with S3 then Lambda actions, SES configuration set with event destination to SNS then Lambda, delivery EventBridge rule and sweeper schedule, alarms, least-privilege roles. Delegation NS records go through the existing management DNS stack. Deploy development only in this task; never cdk deploy --all.

Acceptance criteria:
- cdk synth and infra tests pass; tests assert rules of other environments are untouched and no IAM user or access key exists
- Development stack deploys through the existing pipeline or deploy script; the receipt rule set becomes active
- Role policies are path and ARN scoped (S3 prefix, SES identity, configuration set)
- No SES production access or quota request is made; sandbox limits (200 per day, 1 per second) are documented in the stack README comment-free docs section of the contract
- Read-only AWS verification commands for the runbook are listed (no account ids printed)

Gherkin: none (infrastructure or owner task); infra tests or a runbook are the evidence.

Depends on: secrets story chatticus-a17075 only if a generated secret is needed

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).
